guide.caveborn.solar.title: Solar Infusion
guide.caveborn.solar.content.basics: Solar Infusion is a light-based upgrade system. It does not replace enchantments. It adds special behavior to selected items and marks them with a golden glint.\nMost infused tools use right click or a combat trigger. Abilities usually cost durability and have cooldowns.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.crystal: Solar Crystals are made from amethyst shards. Drop amethyst under open sky during clear daytime. After about 60 seconds in full sunlight, lightning flashes and the shard becomes a Solar Crystal.\nRain, night, shade, or low sky light resets the exposure timer.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.infusion: Use an anvil to combine a valid item with a Solar Crystal. The result keeps the item and adds Solar Infusion.\nSupported items include swords, axes, bow, trident, arrows, mace, wind charges, shields, ender pearls, hogweed paste, the rusted miner's key, and the Vacuumite Magnet.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.indicator: Some infused items use shared solar points. When one of those items is held, a 0/100 indicator appears in the bottom-left corner.\nThe points belong to the player, not to a single item: if one weapon fills the indicator, another supported item sees the same amount. The infused Vacuumite Sword gains points by collapsing Void Wounds, while the infused Bronze Axe collects souls.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.abilities: Choose an infused item on the left. Each icon opens a page for that item's solar behavior.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.event_altar: Build the altar from bronze blocks, gold blocks, crimson stems, and a respawn anchor. When the structure is complete, lightning binds it together.\nThe altar menu contains quests and trials. Quests refresh every 30 minutes and grant altar XP plus rewards. Trials start mob waves or altar defense.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.swords: Infused swords use right click abilities. Wooden launches a target upward. Stone creates a wall. Gold grants strength. Iron drops anvils. Diamond traps with cobweb. Netherite burns and withers. Bronze teleports. Copper summons temporary breezes. Netherite Titanium can call Solar Strike.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.shield: An infused shield stores light while blocking. Hold block for at least half a second, then release to emit a solar wave in front of you.\nA longer block charges a wider and stronger wave. Undead take extra damage and ignite. The shield then enters cooldown and loses durability.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.magnet: A Vacuumite Magnet pulls dropped items while carried. Infusing it doubles the pull strength and expands the range from 8 to 16 blocks.\nA charged infused magnet can strike an entity: first hit deals 5 damage and knockback, then a second pulse after half a second deals 2 more. The magnet visually discharges and recharges over 15 seconds.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.wind: Infused wind charges keep their throw behavior, but their impact creates an extra solar explosion if the ability is enabled.\nThis is meant for burst movement, crowd control, and risky combat plays.
guide.caveborn.solar.content.cooldowns: Solar abilities share a simple rhythm: charge, release, recover. If an ability does nothing, check cooldown, item durability, server config, and whether the item is actually infused.\nServer operators can reload the solar config with /caveborn reload.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.wooden_swor: Right click to launch the nearest target upward.\nUse it to interrupt enemies, create breathing room, or set up fall damage.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.stone_sword: Right click to raise a temporary stone wall.\nUse it to block paths, stop arrows, or split a group of mobs.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.golden_swor: Right click to gain a burst of Strength.\nGold stays fragile, but infusion turns it into a risky damage window.
Right click to drop anvils on the target area.\nBest against slow enemies or mobs trapped in a tight space.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.diamond_swo: Right click to trap the target in cobwebs.\nThis is a control tool for stopping fast mobs before they reach you.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.netherite_s: Right click to punish a target with hellfire and wither.\nIt is built for hard single targets, not crowd clearing.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.bronze_swor: Right click to teleport.\nUse bronze infusion as a movement and escape tool.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.copper_swor: Right click to summon temporary breezes around you.\nThey act like short-lived pets and help pressure hostile mobs.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.mace.conten: Right click to create a wind-charge style burst.\nUse it for space control and explosive movement.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.solar_strik: Right click to call Solar Strike on the nearest target.\nThis is the late-game solar finisher: repeated lightning on one enemy.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.shield.cont: Hold block to charge light, then release to emit a wave in front of you.\nLonger block means stronger knockback and range. Undead take extra damage and ignite.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.magnet.cont: While carried, it pulls dropped items from 16 blocks with double strength.\nWhen charged, hit an entity to knock it back for 5 damage, then pulse again after half a second for 2 more damage. The magnet recharges over 15 seconds.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.bow.content: Arrows fired from an infused bow leave with 1.5x impulse, making them faster and deadlier.\nA target hit by the arrow is set on fire.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.trident.con: A thrown infused trident flies 1.25x faster. Dry targets ignite. Wet targets release a steam burst that damages and knocks back nearby enemies.\nAquatic mobs take +3 extra damage, and Loyalty pulls the trident back faster.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.arrow.conte: A solar-infused arrow deals +2 base damage.\nOn hit, lightning strikes the target.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.spectral_ar: A solar-infused spectral arrow can break up to 2 fragile blocks in its path, up to and including stone hardness, without losing speed.\nOn hit, lightning strikes the target.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.wind_charge: Throwing an infused wind charge creates an extra solar explosion on impact.\nUse it for burst movement, crowd control, and risky plays.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.crystal_dus: Right-click a block to scatter a 3x3 solar crystal dust field for 5 seconds.\nEveryone except the owner takes 3 damage per second and Wither for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.totem.conte: When a solar totem triggers, the player is fully healed, becomes completely immune to damage for 2 seconds, and gains fiery strikes for 5 seconds.\nWhile active, attacks ignite the target and deal +2 damage. If an infused totem is in the offhand, attacks always deal +2 damage.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.vacuumite_s: Collapsing a Void Wound with an infused Vacuumite Sword grants +5 shared solar points.\nAt 40 points, right click to spend them and activate a 10 second burst: every hit triggers Void Wound damage and ignites the target, but does not generate solar points.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.ender_pearl: A solar-infused ender pearl is thrown 75%% stronger than normal.\nTeleporting with it deals no pearl damage, then releases a small void flash that knocks nearby mobs away.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.hogweed_pas: Solar-infused hogweed paste becomes a harsher trap.\nTouching it slows much more strongly, keeps the victim burning, and leaves Solar Burn for 10 seconds after they step away.
guide.caveborn.solar.ability.rusted_mine: Right click to use the call of the sun and show the distance to the nearest locked miner's crate in the actionbar.\nIt only finds locked crates, has a 5 second cooldown, and spends 1 durability. The key has 20 durability; when the last durability breaks, lightning strikes the player.
Kills with an infused Bronze Axe release souls. A soul flies to the player like experience and grants +5 shared solar points.\nWith at least 10 points, pressing jump again in midair performs a higher double jump. Landing prevents fall damage, costs 50 axe durability, deals 8 area damage, knocks enemies away, and leaves a ring of fire.
Passive knife abilities:
Infusion gives +1 damage and raises attack speed to 2.8. The knife has two modes: solo and duo.
Solo - with one infused Zinc Knife in hand, right click spends 10 solar points and dashes 2 blocks.
Duo - with infused Zinc Knives in both hands, attacks cycle through main hand, offhand, then both knives together. The third hit deals damage with both knives, ignites the target, and grants +10 solar points. Right click spends 10 points, dashes 4 blocks, deals 2 damage to mobs in the path, and ignites them.
